layers.rule: only source-observed variables may be populated; no implicit default values
independent experimental context, not inferred from a plate image

rules: fungal cytoplasmic flow is not liquid film flow
liquid film flow is not bacterial movement
bacterial movement is not plant nutrient exchange
Pythium ultimum is oomycete and must never be tagged as true fungus
a path is not a confirmed highway unless each hop has source-supported hyphal support and connected liquid-film evidence
unknown liquid state must never become connected by default
topology alone never proves bacterial dispersal

forbidden: random frame split within same device

proposed_targets_not_results.false_positive_highway: zero confirmed routes in disconnected and unreported liquid controls
proposed_targets_not_results.baseline: improve device-level arrival prediction over hypha-only and liquid-only baselines
proposed_targets_not_results.calibration: nominal 90%/95% intervals within ±3 percentage points on held-out device groups, once sample size supports this estimate
proposed_targets_not_results.generalization: report per-device and worst-stratum outcomes; no global pooling across organism domains

receipt_requirements: filament organism identity and graph-segment reference
bacterial track identity and trajectory receipt
claim_ceiling: Source-specific microbial movement through hypha-associated liquid films; no universal fungal transport or plant nutrient-transfer claim.
